Country coverage and backfill

Country comes from the repository owner’s GitHub location. 1 of 1 repos have a known country; 0 of 1 owners are still unresolved (1 can still be checked). Owners with a stored location or website resolve automatically at no API cost. A backfill only fetches GitHub profiles for owners with no stored signal, then freezes every known country into this detection run’s rows.

One click drains every remaining owner in batches; stored locations resolve instantly and GitHub profile fetches are audited against this run. It can take a while when many owners have no stored location.
